messages:
Nina V: spotted preview vs final invoice mismatches for a few tenants after the routing-priority rollout. preview shows pricing_region=EU but final invoice had pricing_region=US for same sessions. anyone seen similar?
Theo M: saw two alerts last night. replay shows proxy rewrote the route_hint to fallback->global which reset pricing_region downstream.
Ravi S: that would explain it. preview is generated at the edge using headers present at first hop; invoicing uses the canonicalized route_resolution from ingest. race between when pricing_region is stamped and when fallback happens.
Nina V: short-term mitigation idea: mark preview entries as "provisional region" if route_resolution differs from pricing_region header. display in console so CS doesn't rely on preview blindly.
Theo M: long-term fix: ensure proxy carries pricing_region through any fallback rewrite. minimal change: copy existing pricing_region header into the rewritten request unless tenant override exists. canary this for affected tenants first.
Ravi S: agree. also add an ingest-side sanity check: if pricing_region header missing, derive from tenant config rather than recomputing from route_resolution. prevents silent flips.
ingest-bot: synthetic replay 7865432125 run -> pre-patch mismatches 8 events, post-proxy-copy change simulated -> 0 mismatches. link: https://internal/ci/7865432125
Nina V: ok action items: Theo -> proxy patch + tenant canary flag (ETA 6h). Ravi -> ingest fallback to tenant default when header absent (ETA 1 day). Nina -> console badge + message for "provisional region" (ETA 4h).
Theo M: will open PR and wire canary list. small unit tests included.
Ravi S: I'll add a metric pricing_region_mismatch and an alert if >0.05% non-canary tenants in 1h.
Nina V: thanks team, recording this in #eng-platform-action-items and pinging finance/CS for awareness. :thumbsup:
